text:
alex: heads up — seeing a spike in failed mTLS handshakes in ap-south starting ~02:15 UTC. logs show "client_hello: epoch mismatch" and "keystore: missing intermediate". could be related to last night's RBAC prune.

jamie: which services are impacted? any sample logs?

alex: frontdoor-proxy and model-router-1. sample log: `[proxy/handshake] ERROR client=10.2.5.6 err="client_hello: epoch 5 != server 7" ctx="keystore_id=svc-model-router-1"`

katie: we rolled the keystore-reader RBAC change at ~01:50 UTC (PR #4521). that was meant to tighten access. didn't expect KMS denies.

rahul: checking KMS: I see UnwrapKey denies for role keystore-reader starting 02:08 UTC. policy-binding change at 01:48 might align.

sre-oncall: can we get an audit trail for the failing principal so we know exact condition?

alex: grabbing audit now. audit shows principal arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/keystore-reader assumed by svc-account:model-router-1@ap-south. Deny reason: "Condition: aws:SourceVpc != vpc-0a1b2c3d". that condition looks unexpected.

katie: we didn't introduce a vpc condition in the RBAC PR. could this be from a policy templating change? or key policy change?

jamie: also seeing client retries with session-ticket errors: `ptls: session ticket HMAC mismatch`. suggests session resumption keys or KV cache missing on servers. if intermediate certs are missing, tickets can't be validated.

kms-bot: AUTOMATED: KMS request 0x9fab failed: AccessDenied on Decrypt at 2026-03-20T02:09:02Z. Requestor: arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/keystore-reader. KeyId: alias/keystore-ap-south.

rahul: hypothesis: during the RBAC prune we unintentionally modified role tags or principal tags used by KMS key policy conditions. KMS key policy might require a tag or vpc-source that the role no longer satisfies.

jamie: mitigation options: 1) revert the RBAC tag change, 2) loosen the KMS key policy to temporarily allow the keystore-reader principal, or 3) route traffic away from ap-south to eu until fixed. what do we prefer for short term?

sre-oncall: fastest is route fallback + short policy tweak. set proxy to prefer eu-backup for TLS handshake failures. also add a metric alert for KMS Unwrap denies.

alex: I'm seeing success rate go from ~60% -> 98% after we forced routing to eu-backup for a subset of traffic. good for mitigation but need durable fix.

rahul: I'll add a temporary KMS policy exception for `arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/keystore-reader` scoped to a 1h window and ap-south key. will monitor.

katie: I'll open a rollback PR to revert the role tag changes and add a CI test that asserts KMS key policy conditions (tag/vpc) are valid for each role we publish. PR in flight: #4534.

alex: actionable list: 
- revert role-tag PR + redeploy (owner: katie)
- add KMS key-policy temporary exception (owner: rahul)
- create an alert for KMS Unwrap AccessDenied with runbook link (owner: jamie)
- add integration test for key-policy vs role attributes in CI (owner: katie)
- postmortem and update RBAC rollout checklist to include KMS policy verification (owner: alex)

katie: noted. will include test matrices for region-scoped key policies and vpc/tag conditions.

rahul: patched key policy; monitoring shows unwrap failures drop to zero after 30s. will revert exception once rollback confirmed.

alex: thanks all. please add timeline and numbers to the postmortem. leaving this thread open for updates. :thumbsup:
